integrity_statement: The exact spectral polynomials, graph-class census and algebraic inequalities are reproduced by an included standard-library program; finite enumeration is used only for vertex orders four, six and eight. Earlier graph classifications and the general dynamical spectral reduction are acknowledged, not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Strict finite-order and minimality claims concern connected simple cubic equal-competition Lotka–Volterra networks. No statement about arbitrary degree sequences, directed interactions, finite populations with stochasticity, or long-time dynamics beyond the loss of linearly stable positive coexistence.
title: A sharp eight-species reversal of clustering and stable coexistence
